summary: Same centered replicated-fractal flower with correct dial semantics on all 12 controls, but the port draws one fewer arm at every Replicas setting (5-fold vs 3-fold untouched), over-scales per-point brightness ~3x so points clip to flat white instead of breathing, and opens with a bright flash the original fades in from.
observations: Both sides compile and render with no compile/runtime errors on the default 16x16 grid rig; neither binds sensors (wantsSensors false on both).

Same family on both sides: a roughly centered, radially replicated fractal 'flower' of dots that hue-walks continuously. Over a 240 s untouched window the brightness centroid sits near grid centre on both (orig offset 0.06-1.22 px, port 0.00-2.19 px from (7.5,7.5)), and mean radial extent is comparable (orig ~3.9 px, port ~4.9 px).

SYMMETRY ORDER, untouched: dominant angular harmonic (brightness-vs-angle DFT about centre, 12 frames sampled every 20 s across 240 s) is k=5 on the original in 8/12 frames, and k=3 on the port in 10/12 frames. The original's default figure is a 5-point flower; the port's is a 3-armed squiggle.

REPLICAS MAPPING OFF BY ONE: sweeping sliderReplicas at 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 with all other sliders pinned at 0.5 (24 s window, 7 dumped frames each), the dominant angular harmonic is orig 1 / 4 / 7 / 10 / >=12 versus port 1 / 3 / 6 / 9 / 12. The port is consistently one arm short (orig ~ 12*v+1, port ~ 12*v).

PER-POINT BRIGHTNESS IS OVER-SCALED AND CLIPS. Cleanest case, Iterations=0, Replicas=0, Trails=0, 48x48 grid: at t=3/6/9 s the original lights exactly 4 pixels whose value modulates 10 -> 76 -> 184, while the port lights 9 pixels pinned at 255 at all three times (total energy exactly 2295 = 9*255 every frame). The original's slow per-point brightness breathing is lost to saturation on the port.

OVERALL BRIGHTNESS ~2-3x TOO HIGH at every matched dial setting: untouched 6 s baseline meanBrightness avg orig 7.1 / port 27.8; all-sliders-at-0.5 12 s run orig 4.8 / port 16.1; skip-90 s late window orig 5.2 / port 9.0; Trails=0 orig 2.4 / port 13.8. Confirmed by dump at Trails=0 with all else 0.5: orig lit 22-57 px at avg peak 12-56, port lit 68-78 px at avg peak 68-144. Compensating the arm-count mismatch (orig Replicas=0.25 vs port 0.3333, both 4-fold) still leaves the port ~1.8x more lit pixels and ~2.5x the total energy, so the brightness excess is separate from the replica bug.

ITERATIONS DEPTH GROWS FASTER ON THE PORT: at Replicas=0, Spacing=1, 48x48, lit-pixel counts at Iterations 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 are orig 4 / 20-28 / 48-124 / 72-368 / 100-304 versus port 9 / 18-36 / 72-162 / 261-567 / 594-1566. Same dial value yields ~2-5x more drawn points on the port at the high end.

STARTUP TRANSIENT: the original fades in from black in every run (meanBrightness 0,0,0,1,1,1,2,2,2,3,... reaching a peak of 17 at ~1.2 s), while the port opens at or near full brightness and decays (75,86,85,87,88,85,... down to ~19 by 2 s). Reproduced in baseline, dial-mid, survey-240 and every ctl-* run: port 'first' brightness 43-75 against orig 0.

CONTROL SURFACE MISMATCH: the original exposes 12 sliders; the port exposes 9 sliders plus 3 toggles. sliderWhiteMode / sliderPinwheelMode / sliderWrapMode are renamed AND re-kinded to toggleWhiteMode / togglePinwheelMode / toggleWrapMode. Labels still match (WhiteMode / PinwheelMode / WrapMode).

MOTION CHARACTER: neither side is periodic - autocorrelation of the motion series decays monotonically with no peak, over a 20 s / 10 fps late window and a 60 s / 5 fps survey, on both sides. Both evolve continuously and aperiodically. motionLit runs ~2x higher on the port throughout, in proportion to its brightness inflation.

COLOR WALK MATCHES IN FAMILY: at Replicas=1 both cycle the full hue circle at roughly one hue per second, agreeing step-for-step for the first ~6 s (green, blue, magenta/red, olive/yellow-green, teal) before drifting apart. No palette-family divergence found.

RESOLUTION INDEPENDENCE MATCHES: re-rendered at 8x8, 16x16 and 48x48 both sides draw the same logical figure at different detail (orig mean 7 / 7 / 5, port 28 / 28 / 28); neither rasterizes at native resolution.
Both sides are seed-independent: seeds 1, 7 and 1234 produce byte-identical meanBrightness series on each side, so no stochastic caveat applies.

dials.name: sliderIterations
dials.origEffect: fractal recursion depth; brightness 0.9 -> 4.8 -> 17.3 across 0/0.5/1, drawn point count 4 -> ~90 -> ~230 (48x48, single arm)
dials.portEffect: same axis and direction, brightness 2.8 -> 16.1 -> 44.3, but point count 9 -> ~110 -> ~1100 - grows 2-5x faster for the same dial value

dials.name: sliderDrawLevels
dials.origEffect: weakest dial; slightly more of the recursion visible, brightness 2.9 -> 4.8 across 0/1

dials.name: sliderScale
dials.origEffect: spreads the figure across the grid; brightness 2.4 -> 4.1 and motionLit 19.4 -> 4.2 across 0/1 (larger figure moves more slowly per pixel)
dials.portEffect: same spreading, but brightness 3 -> 17.8 and motionLit barely drops (23.7 -> 19.9) - response magnitude much stronger and the slow-down is missing

dials.name: sliderSpeed
dials.origEffect: raises evolution rate; motionLit 3.9 -> 7.1 across 0/1 with brightness roughly flat (7.1 -> 5.3)

dials.name: sliderAngleRange1
dials.origEffect: narrows/reshapes the branch fan; brightness 6.2 -> 4.6 across 0/1

dials.name: sliderAngleRange2
dials.origEffect: second branch-angle range; brightness 6.8 -> 5.8 across 0/1, mild

dials.name: sliderTrails
dials.origEffect: persistence; at 0 sparse isolated dots (brightness 2.4, motionLit 13.4), at 1 smeared accumulation (brightness 21.3, motionLit 1.8)

dials.name: sliderReplicas
dials.origEffect: rotational symmetry order; dominant angular harmonic 1 / 4 / 7 / 10 / >=12 at v = 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1
dials.portEffect: same axis but one arm short at every setting: 1 / 3 / 6 / 9 / 12

dials.name: sliderSpacing
dials.origEffect: separation between drawn points; brightness 1.8 -> 4.9 and motionLit 4.9 -> 6.9 across 0/1

dials.name: WhiteMode (orig sliderWhiteMode / port toggleWhiteMode)
dials.origEffect: at 1 the points desaturate toward white and brighten (brightness 6.0 -> 8.2 over a 30 s window)

dials.name: PinwheelMode (orig sliderPinwheelMode / port togglePinwheelMode)
dials.origEffect: at 1 the arms shear into a swept/pinwheel arrangement and dim slightly (brightness 6.0 -> 4.5)

dials.name: WrapMode (orig sliderWrapMode / port toggleWrapMode)
dials.origEffect: inert at default Scale (probe maxDelta 0.60 over 4 s), but live once the figure overflows the grid: at Scale=1 over 20 s, brightness 4.5 -> 8.7 and motionLit 4.4 -> 6.1 across 0/1
dials.portEffect: also live at Scale=1: brightness 26.8 -> 37.1, motionLit 31.2 -> 28.1 across 0/1

feedback: Replica count is one short across the whole Replicas range. Measured dominant angular harmonic at Replicas 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1: original 1/4/7/10/>=12, port 1/3/6/9/12. The port needs one more replica at every non-zero setting (original behaves like 12*value+1 arms, port like 12*value), while still collapsing to a single arm at 0.

The untouched default figure has the wrong symmetry order: the original is 5-fold (measured on 8 of 12 frames sampled across 240 s), the port is 3-fold (10 of 12). Fixing the off-by-one above is not sufficient - the default Replicas value also needs to land on 5 arms, not 3.

Per-point brightness is over-scaled and clipping. At Iterations=0 / Replicas=0 / Trails=0 on a 48x48 grid the original's 4 points modulate 10 -> 76 -> 184 over t=3/6/9 s; the port's points sit at exactly 255 at all three times. Scale the per-point brightness down so it stays under saturation and the original's slow brightness breathing becomes visible again; today it is flattened into constant white.

Overall output is 2-3x too bright at every matched dial setting (all-sliders-0.5: orig meanBrightness 4.8 vs port 16.1; untouched baseline 7.1 vs 27.8; late window 5.2 vs 9.0). Roughly half of this survives compensating the replica off-by-one, so it is a separate gain/normalisation issue, not a consequence of the extra arms.

The port opens with a bright flash: meanBrightness starts at 43-75 and decays over ~2 s, while the original starts at 0 and fades in over ~1.2 s to a peak of 17. Whatever accumulator or trail buffer the original starts empty, the port starts full (or draws before the first fade step).

Iterations grows the drawn point count far too fast at the top of its range: at Iterations=1 (single arm, 48x48) the original lights 100-304 pixels, the port 594-1566. The low end matches (0.25: orig 20-28, port 18-36), so the mapping diverges progressively - check the depth-to-value curve rather than the endpoints.

Scale behaves differently at the high end: on the original, Scale=1 slows the apparent motion sharply (motionLit 19.4 at Scale=0 down to 4.2 at Scale=1) while barely raising brightness (2.4 -> 4.1). On the port, motion hardly slows (23.7 -> 19.9) and brightness jumps (3 -> 17.8). The original appears to scale the figure without adding drawn points; the port adds them.
AngleRange2 responds in the opposite direction: raising it 0 -> 1 dims the original (brightness 6.8 -> 5.8) but brightens the port (8.1 -> 15.2). Worth re-checking the sense/range of that angle term.

Control surface: the original exposes sliderWhiteMode, sliderPinwheelMode and sliderWrapMode as SLIDERS; the port renames and re-kinds them to toggleWhiteMode, togglePinwheelMode and toggleWrapMode. Restore the original names and slider kind so saved control values and the UI surface match - the original's slider form also admits intermediate values the port's toggle cannot express.

Everything else is right: same centered replicated-fractal-flower family, same centering, resolution-independent on both sides, same aperiodic (non-cycling) evolution, matching hue-walk family and rate, and 9 of 12 dials matching in direction and character. Both sides are deterministic and seed-independent.
